plan: The validation bug is that sorting by phase before modeling destroys acquisition-row order, so the “order trend” is actually a phase-sorted index; shuffled folds also leak neighboring phases into training and do not test interpolation across held-out phase regions. Keep the original row index as an order proxy, compare fixed low-order Fourier, constant, and linear-order models using contiguous phase-block cross-validation, and report predictive metrics explicitly as exploratory. The replacement uses only the mean-phase scan, keeps DOP in its native scale, and reports Stokes squared norm separately without treating it as DOP or inferring replicate-based significance.
